title: UNITE: Consolidating Embodied VLM Specialists via Shared-Anchor One-Bit Factorization
abstract: arXiv:2611.20767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embodied capabilities such as visual grounding, spatial reasoning, navigation, and driving understanding are often developed in separate vision-language specialists fine-tuned from a common pretrained model.Deploying the specialists separately multiplies storage, whereas merging them into one dense model forces conflicting task updates to share parameters and loses part of each specialist's expertise.We introduce UNITE, a framework that consolidates such specialists into a compact shared-backbone mixture of experts. UNITE keeps the feed-forward block of each specialist as a routable expert and represents the expert bank through a shared-anchor one-bit factorization: a shared floating-point anchor plus expert-specific, row-scaled binary deviations.The anchor is optimized jointly with the scales and signs through closed-form alternating updates, using only source weights and no calibration data.Router adaptation then adjusts token-level ex

translated_title: UNITE：通过共享锚点单比特因式分解整合具身视觉语言专家模型
translated_abstract: 视觉定位、空间推理、导航和驾驶理解等具身能力通常是通过从同一个预训练模型微调出的相互独立的视觉语言专家模型来开发的。单独部署这些专家模型会使存储需求成倍增加，而将它们合并为一个稠密模型又会迫使相互冲突的任务更新共享参数，从而损失每个专家的部分专长。我们提出了UNITE，一个将这些专家模型整合为紧凑的共享骨干混合专家模型的框架。UNITE保留每个专家模型的前馈块作为可路由的专家，并通过共享锚点单比特因式分解来表示专家库：即一个共享的浮点锚点加上每个专家特有的、按行缩放的二值偏移。锚点通过与缩放系数和符号的闭式交替更新进行联合优化，仅使用源权重而无需任何校准数据。随后，路由器自适应机制对token级的专家选择进行调整，以……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: UNITE提出共享锚点单比特因式分解方法，将多个具身任务视觉语言专家模型整合为一个紧凑的共享骨干混合专家模型，无需校准数据即可在大幅节省存储的同时保留各专家的专有能力。
en_tdlr: UNITE consolidates multiple embodied vision-language specialists into a compact shared-backbone mixture of experts via shared-anchor one-bit factorization, preserving each specialist's expertise while drastically reducing storage without any calibration data.
